mapper.select: /*selectCommonMpIvAgrmntDetailPopList*/ SELECT A.KEP_USER_ID , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_NAME , A.SUPPLIER_USER_NAME , F_GET_CMCD_NAME('M065', A.REASON_CODE) AS REASON_CODE , A.REASON_REMARK , A.APPROVAL_RD_DATE -- 납품합의일 , TO_CHAR(A.CREATE_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CREATE_DATE -- 납품조정일 FROM KEP_PO_DELY_MNG A WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND A.PO_SEQ = #{st_po_seq} /* AND A.SEQ = ( SELECT MAX(SEQ) FROM KEP_PO_DELY_MNG WHERE BUYER=A.BUYER AND PO_NO=A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ=A.PO_SEQ ) */ ORDER BY A.CREATE_DATE

/*selectCommonMpIvAgrmntDetailPopMailYn*/ -- SLOGIC-BEGIN(P07-0000019) SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 0, 'Y', 'N') AS MAIL_YN --Y: 체크버튼 visible true, N: visible false FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000019' AND B.COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} -- SLOGIC-END
